literal_meaning: ধর্মীয় জপ বা আল্লাহর নামের পুনরাবৃত্তিমূলক উচ্চারণ
figurative_meaning_en: Repeated utterance of the same words
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একই কথা জিকির করে যাচ্ছে, কান পাতার মতো নেই।
বাচ্চাটা তার দাবি জিকির করতে লাগল।
example_sentences_in_english: He keeps repeating the same thing like zikir, not listening at all.
The child started doing zikir on his demand.
history: Derived from the Islamic practice of dhikr (zikir), a form of devotional repetition of God's names in Sufism and general Muslim worship, adapted figuratively in Bengali to denote monotonous repetition.
note: Variations reflect regional phonetic differences in Bengali dialects; often used in Muslim-majority contexts but applicable generally.
